Researcher: 김용환 (KIM YONG HWAN)
Affiliation: 지능형영상처리연구센터
Keywords: 2D/3D 비디오 코덱, HEVC, AV1, V-PCC, V-DMC, Hadoop/Spark
Introduction: From 1999 to 2001, he was worked with SungJin C&C, Seoul, where he optimized MPEG-1/2 Video CODEC for DVR. 
Since 2001, he has been with KETI, Seongnam, South Korea, where he is currently a Chief Researcher with the Intelligent Image Processing Research Center. His current research interests include V-PCC, V-DMC, VVC, AV1, MIV video coding, and its optimized implementation.
